# AutoResearchClaw: repairing twenty scattered regressions without a test suite

I have been driving this study-automation toolkit end to end and hit a pile of unrelated misbehaviours in one sitting. Nothing about my inputs or my configuration changed. The repository has received 20 separate undocumented edits. Everything below is what I reproduced, written as what I did and what came back instead.

Gathering material from the outside. Asking it to look things up on the open internet with a cap on how many hits I want returns a count that is not the cap, no longer drops hits that merely point back at the site which produced the listing, and no longer suppresses an address an earlier lookup already returned. Pulling the latest publications from a subscribed source keeps the same title when it arrives twice and keeps entries whose title is empty or nothing but whitespace. Reducing a short phrase to its salient terms silently drops the shortest ones, so a sentence mixing ordinary words with a three-letter acronym comes back without the acronym.

Setting a trial up and getting it running. When the model answers the planning step with an empty object, that step used to stop cleanly: paused for human attention, a recorded decision that the reply lacked the required shape, a small metadata file naming the plan sections that were missing, and deliberately no plan file at all.
